blocks.x: Was Darnell still in the band at that time? He doubled fiddle.
I'm trying to think, were they in the band at the same time I don't think they were in the band at the same time.
Darnell, I know, recorded at least one fiddle solo on I think it was "Cavernism."
But -- well, first Darnell and later Ray, were they featured at the Terrace, do you know, on some violin solos?
Truck told me that he worked some with Darnell, and he claims he's the best fiddle player of them all.
Yeah, he was good. Him and Joe Venuti used to hook up there. They were great friends, they were buddies. Yeah.
Were you at any of those sessions?
Yeah. Joe used to come by the Terrace and sit in.
What would he do? Would he --
